title: State citations and penalties by Bay Area county, 2021 to November 2026
question: How many State enforcement actions did Bay Area health facilities receive each year, and where?
finding: Checked; nothing unusual for San Francisco. California: 7,662 actions since January 2021, 1,723 of them nursing-hours penalties. Bay Area: 650; San Francisco 55 (43 at nursing homes; final amounts $1.6 million).
how: Dashboard details export, counted by county and penalty issue year; all facility types.
limits: 2026 is a part year (to 13 November). Counts reflect inspection workload and the number and size of facilities in each county as much as conduct.
